c1510dc816b98093.description: Our client a well established business group is building its presence in the hospitality space in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a focus on delivering a strong customer experience, consistent product standards, and well-run day-to-day operations. Their concept is a Crepe Kiosk in a shopping mall. Apt Resources is managing the search for this position on behalf of the client. This opportunity is suited to a commercially minded hospitality leader who enjoys combining operational discipline with hands-on team leadership. As F&B Manager, you will play a central role in shaping the performance of the concept, supporting service excellence, and helping create a reliable, high-quality guest experience while working closely with teams and suppliers. Responsibilities Oversee daily kiosk operations, service quality, hygiene, and food safety. Manage staffing, scheduling, training, performance, and team development. Monitor sales, inventory, food costs, budgets, and operational profitability. Implement brand standards and ensure consistent product quality across operations. Coordinate with suppliers and resolve operational issues in the DRC market. 5+ years of general management experience in hospitality or quick-service food operations. Proven ability to drive sales performance, manage budgets, and improve operational profitability. Strong knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards, inventory control, and cost controls. Experience managing, training, and motivating frontline teams. Fluency in both French and English. Willingness to relocate to Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Experience in a kiosk, retail food environment, or QSR setting is a plus. Education in hospitality is an advantage. USD 1200 to USD 1800 Plus free accommodation plus other benefits

c1608583a7cd9903.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking an Assistant Inspector to support inspection, monitoring, and compliance activities for a major infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting senior inspectors and project teams to ensure construction activities adhere to approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, contractual requirements, local regulations, and industry best practices. The Assistant Inspector will contribute to the successful delivery of project objectives throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Assist in conducting site inspections and monitoring construction activities across design support, construction, commissioning, and project handover stages. Review approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and technical submissions to support inspection activities. Ensure construction works comply with project requirements, local authority regulations, approved designs, and quality standards. Monitor contractor performance and verify site activities are progressing according to approved plans and schedules. Inspect site works, materials, workmanship, and installations for compliance with project specifications. Coordinate inspection activities with architectural, structural, civil, infrastructure, landscape, utility, and specialist discipline teams. Conduct routine site inspections and document observations, deficiencies, non-conformances, and corrective actions. Monitor project risks related to construction quality and support mitigation measures. Participate in coordination meetings with contractors, consultants, clients, utility providers, and project stakeholders. Assist in reviewing RFIs, inspection requests, material approvals, and technical documentation. Track inspection records, site reports, non-conformance reports, and project performance metrics. Support testing, commissioning, snagging, de-snagging, and project handover inspections. Assist procurement and project teams during material inspections, factory inspections, and vendor-related quality reviews as needed. Support the timely resolution of technical and quality issues affecting project delivery. Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality management requirements during site activities. Support senior inspectors and project teams in maintaining project quality standards and compliance. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Landscape Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 3-7 years of experience in construction inspection, site supervision, quality inspection, or engineering support roles, preferably within PMC, consultancy, infrastructure, landscape, or client-side project environments. Proven experience supporting large-scale infrastructure, landscape, transportation, utilities, mixed-use, or mega development projects. Experience supporting construction inspections, testing and commissioning activities, quality audits, and project handover processes. Familiarity with international standards, local authority regulations, project governance requirements, and construction best practices. Experience working within PMC environments and coordinating with multiple stakeholders. Experience within Middle East mega projects, infrastructure developments, landscape projects, smart cities, or government-led developments is preferred. Required Skills Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, inspection procedures, quality assurance practices, and site supervision requirements. Thorough understanding of construction drawings, specifications, project documentation, and construction quality standards. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, inspection reporting systems, digital project management tools, and construction management platforms. Ability to monitor construction progress, quality performance, project risks, and compliance requirements effectively. Strong observation, communication, reporting, and stakeholder coordination skills. Excellent communication, presentation, and technical reporting abilities. Professional certifications related to construction inspection, quality management, civil engineering, or project supervision are advantageous. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c17984ea2018b1cb.description: About us Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer-centric financial super-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in KSA, UAE and Kuwait, and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, Amazon, IKEA, eXtra and Farfetch as well as small and medium businesses. Tamara is Saudi’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others, operating out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia with other regional and global support offices. Your role Lead and manage a team of internal tele-callers focused on debt collections Define agent efficiency KPIs to monitor day to day performance Monitor daily team performance against defined KPIs and collection targets Conduct regular team huddles, one-on-one reviews, and performance appraisals Ensure adherence to regulatory compliance and internal quality standards in all collection activities. Provide training and development support to team members to improve productivity and call quality. Handle escalations and support resolution of complex customer interactions. Generate daily, weekly, and monthly performance and productivity reports. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to streamline collection workflows and system improvements. Do comparative analysis with industry best practices and suggest improvements in Tamara collection process. Your responsibilities We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Collection Team Lead to manage our internal tele-calling collection team in KSA. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing a team of more than five collectors, creating strategies for collection calling, ensuring daily targets are met, maintaining high standards of compliance and call quality, and driving performance improvements. At least 1–2 years of proven experience managing a collections or tele-calling team Strong leadership and team management skills. Proficiency in MS EXCEL and or collection CRM systems. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical mindset and results-driven approach. Fluency in Arabic and English is preferred. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply!

c1eafb1cee8ebcfe.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز نفس الطبي عن مسؤول رعاية أطفال للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على توفير الرعاية والإشراف على الأطفال في مراكز الرعاية النهارية، وتقديم المساعدة في الأنشطة الأساسية ومراقبة سلوكهم لتحسينه. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية توفير الرعاية الأساسية للأطفال الصغار، بما في ذلك المساعدة في الغسيل، تبديل الملابس، تناول الطعام، وتقديم الأدوية عند الحاجة. مساعدة الأطفال على تطوير الاعتماد على الذات في أداء الأنشطة اليومية. المساهمة في تحضير المواد والمعدات اللازمة للأنشطة التعليمية والترفيهية للأطفال. مراقبة سلوك الأطفال وإدارته، والتواصل معهم ومع أولياء أمورهم لمناقشة سبل تحسين السلوك. متابعة النمو العام للأطفال وتحديد أي مشاكل جسدية أو عقلية محتملة لديهم. التواصل الفعال مع أولياء الأمور، أخصائيي التعليم، وأخصائيي طب الأطفال بشأن اهتمامات الأطفال. إدارة الفصول الدراسية والمحافظة عليها، بالإضافة إلى ساحات اللعب والمرافق الأخرى مثل مرافق الألعاب والمعدات واللوازم. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال رعاية الأطفال. القدرة على توفير الرعاية والإشراف الفعال على الأطفال. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتفاعل مع الأطفال وأولياء أمورهم والزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل مسؤول رعاية الأطفال في مركز نفس الطبي بجدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة مخصصة لرعاية الأطفال. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المرافق المخصصة لرعاية الأطفال. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. المدينة: جدة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

c173bca5cc605459.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايوان للتجارة عن فني إنشاءات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الأبنية، بما في ذلك جمع العينات ومطابقة المواصفات وتقدير الكميات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة مهندس الأبنية في إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل للمعاينة ومتابعة التنفيذ وضبط الجودة. أخذ عينات من تربة موقع البناء ومواد الإنشاء والخلطات الإسمنتية وإرسالها للمختبر لمطابقة المواصفات. تفقد العمل في إنشاء الأبنية أثناء الإنشاء وبعده للتأكد من مطابقة المواصفات والمعايير. المشاركة في قياس العمل المنجز بالتنسيق مع المهندس المشرف على المشروع. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المهارات الفنية القدرة على صيانة وتنفيذ أعمال الدهان والتشطيبات لمختلف الأسطح، بما في ذلك الأثاث والأبواب والجدران والأسقف. معرفة بتقدير كميات المواد والعمالة اللازمة للمشاريع الإنشائية. القدرة على جمع العينات من تربة الموقع والمواد الإنشائية وإرسالها للمختبر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإنشاءات أو دور فني ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل في الرياض. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الإنشاءات ضمن فريق عمل في بيئة ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، ويسهم في ضمان جودة المشاريع الإنشائية للشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة ايوان للتجارة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض.

c1dd543b08b84a8d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إيه إم جى كير عن كاتب استقبال مرضى للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تجربة استقبال سلسة وفعالة للمرضى، من خلال إدارة تسجيل البيانات وتنسيق المواعيد والتعامل مع الحالات الطارئة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مقابلة المرضى وتسجيل بياناتهم الشخصية وبيانات التأمين الصحي، والتحقق من مواعيد الحجز المسبق أو تحديد الاحتياجات الفورية من العيادات. ملء النماذج الخاصة بالاستقبال وإدخال البيانات على النظام الآلي وشبكة معلومات المستشفى، مع ضمان حفظها بشكل صحيح. استكمال المعاملات المالية وترتيب أدوار الحجز، ثم توجيه المريض إلى العيادة المطلوبة للانتظار. استقبال الحالات الطارئة في قسم الطوارئ، وتسجيل بيانات المريض أو المصاب من خلال ذويه أو مرافقيه، أثناء أو بعد تقديم الخدمات الطارئة. إعداد تقارير الاستقبال اليومية وتقارير الطوارئ والعيادات، والالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المرضى بمهنية وفعالية. مهارات جيدة في استخدام أنظمة إدخال البيانات والتعامل مع النماذج الإدارية. بيئة العمل يعمل كاتب استقبال المرضى ضمن فريق شركة إيه إم جى كير في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة لضمان تقديم أفضل خدمة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة إيه إم جى كير.

c1f90b7c87c4f3fb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ركن القمم للصيانة والنظافة عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بدقة، وتحديد أسبابها. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة اللازمة، ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة تنفيذ إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للجداول الزمنية المحددة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيانة الميكانيكية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الصيانة في شركة ركن القمم للصيانة والنظافة بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية لضمان استمرارية عمل المعدات بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: المنطقة الشرقية، الدمام الراتب: غير معلن

c158d3c4e880b28c.description: About Foodics and the Role Foodics, established in 2014, is a restaurant management ecosystem and payment technology provider with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across five countries. We are seeking a Senior Risk and BCM Specialist to support the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the company's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Business Continuity Management (BCM), and IT Disaster Recovery (DR) frameworks. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and requires 2-5 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The Senior Risk and BCM Specialist will identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate organizational risks, while ensuring business resilience and operational continuity. This role involves close collaboration with various business units, IT, Information Security, and other stakeholders to strengthen risk management practices and enhance the organization's ability to respond to disruptions. The specialist will ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry best practices, including SAMA regulations, and will contribute to risk assessments, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing, regulatory compliance, and risk reporting. Key Responsibilities Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework. Identify, assess, monitor, and report risks across operational, financial, credit, market, technology, and cybersecurity areas. Maintain and update the enterprise risk register, documenting risks, controls, and mitigation plans. Evaluate control effectiveness and recommend improvements for identified risks. Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework. Coordinate and assist in conducting Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and Business Continuity Risk Assessments. Support the development, review, and maintenance of Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) and recovery strategies. Coordinate BCM tests, exercises, and simulations to assess organizational readiness. Support the development, maintenance, and implementation of IT Disaster Recovery plans and procedures. Coordinate DR planning, testing, and execution with IT and technology teams. Ensure recovery strategies align with business recovery requirements, including Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO). Support the interpretation and implementation of SAMA regulations related to risk management, business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience. Assist in developing and updating risk, BCM, and DR policies, procedures, and frameworks in line with regulatory expectations. Prepare periodic risk, BCM, and DR reports, dashboards, and key risk indicators (KRIs) for management review. Monitor risk exposures, control effectiveness, BCM readiness, and DR performance. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in risk management, business continuity, or disaster recovery. Demonstrated understanding of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks. Experience with Business Continuity Management (BCM) and IT Disaster Recovery (DR) planning and execution. Familiarity with SAMA regulations and industry best practices in risk and resilience. Ability to conduct risk assessments, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), and scenario analysis. Strong analytical and reporting skills for preparing risk reports and dashboards. Work Environment and Benefits Foodics offers an inclusive and diverse culture that supports innovation and flexibility. The company provides competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and potential for shares. Employees benefit from personal development opportunities, regular training, and an annual learning stipend. The team comprises over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, offering a collaborative and challenging environment with opportunities for growth. Application Process We encourage qualified candidates to apply for this role to contribute to Foodics' proactive approach to managing risks and business disruptions.

c171d764dac940a8.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Product Management to join Qiddiya Digital in Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves taking end-to-end product ownership of critical digital capabilities across Qiddiya’s ecosystem. The Senior Manager will work closely with a Lead Software Engineer to form the core product and engineering leadership, ensuring business objectives, customer needs, technical quality, and operational requirements are met throughout the product lifecycle. Product Leadership and Accountability The Senior Manager - Product Management will be accountable for the product roadmap, priorities, requirements, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes for their assigned digital domain. This position also involves overseeing vendor product and delivery teams, ensuring that Qiddiya maintains ownership of its roadmap, product decisions, requirements, and domain knowledge. Key Responsibilities Own the product roadmap and priorities for the assigned digital domain. Translate business objectives and customer needs into clear product capabilities, requirements, and measurable outcomes. Partner with the Lead Software Engineer to align product priorities with architecture, technical feasibility, platform health, and engineering capacity. Maintain and prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, business impact, risk, dependencies, and technical considerations. Define clear business requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, success measures, and non-functional expectations. Ensure product capabilities are designed for reuse across Qiddiya’s assets, brands, channels, and customer journeys. Lead discovery activities, including stakeholder workshops, customer research, journey analysis, process mapping, and solution validation. Coordinate dependencies and integration requirements across internal platforms, external partners, and related product domains. Provide product direction and oversight to vendor delivery teams, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya’s priorities and standards. Ensure that product decisions, requirements, documentation, and platform knowledge are retained within Qiddiya. Define product KPIs and use data, customer insights, operational feedback, and platform performance to guide prioritization. Monitor adoption, conversion, customer experience, operational performance, and business outcomes after release. Support incident management by assessing customer and business impact, coordinating stakeholder communication, and prioritizing remediation. Balance the delivery of new capabilities with technical debt, resilience, compliance, operational improvement, and platform sustainability. Maintain clear communication on roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected outcomes. Qualifications and Experience 7+ years of product management experience within complex digital, technology, or customer-facing environments. Proven experience owning digital products from discovery through delivery, launch, operation, and continuous improvement. Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, digital platforms, data flows, cloud services, and modern software delivery practices. Experience managing products within areas such as commerce, checkout, loyalty, customer accounts, mobile experiences, ticketing, payments, or digital platforms. Strong experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, business requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. Proven ability to work closely with engineering teams and make informed product and technical trade-offs. Experience overseeing vendors, system integrators, or outsourced product and delivery teams. Required Skills Strong analytical skills and experience using product, customer, operational, and commercial data to guide decisions. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, cross-domain dependencies, and complex delivery environments. Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills. Ability to influence teams and stakeholders without relying on direct line-management authority.

c1dbfb1fa967c62d.description: About the Graduate Programme Mace Consult offers a two-year Graduate Programme designed to provide hands-on experience in programme and project delivery consultancy. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a start date in early September 2027. Graduates will contribute to projects focused on shaping sustainable places, developing smarter infrastructure, and addressing complex client challenges. Location and Travel The primary employment location will be at Mace's Riyadh office or a client site within Riyadh. Project assignments may require working at various client locations across the Kingdom, including a site approximately 40km outside Riyadh. Candidates must be comfortable with daily commuting to these locations. Flexibility and an adaptable approach to travel are essential. Mace Consult reimburses eligible business travel expenses in line with company policy. For roles at sites difficult to access by public transport, a valid driving licence and access to a vehicle are required. Sectors and Service Lines Graduates will support clients across various markets. Depending on client and business needs, placements may be within sectors such as: Cities & Places Government & Communities Health, Life Sciences & Technology Mobility (including Rail and Highways) Resilience (including nuclear, energy, and utilities) Opportunities are available across main service lines, including Project & Programme Management, PMO & Planning, and Commercial and Cost Management. Specialised roles in Business Advisory, Work Winning, Digital, Responsible Business, Strategic Advisory, and Information Management may also be available. Responsibilities and Development Participants will gain practical experience on live projects, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams. Responsibilities may include supporting project delivery, planning, design coordination, cost and commercial management, sustainability, risk management, data analysis, or client engagement. The programme includes structured learning, professional development, and mentoring. Graduates will also build professional networks through community initiatives, industry events, and cross-team collaboration. Candidate Requirements Mace Consult seeks proactive individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are committed to making an impact. Candidates should demonstrate creative thinking, adaptability to change, and integrity. c107dfe005bb9ef1.job_title: Airport Services Duty Officer Al Ula SA
c107dfe005bb9ef1.description: About the Role Qatar Airways is seeking an Airport Services Duty Officer to join its Ground Services team in Al Ula, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Role Overview As the Airport Services Duty Officer, you will have overall control of the shift, acting as a direct representative of the Airport Services Manager. Ensure that passenger and aircraft handling practices comply with safety and security standards. Meet all Qatar Airways aircraft handling standards on a shift basis. Manage and control manpower during the shift to optimize utilization and maintain staff morale and discipline. Ensure proper allocation of manpower and resources within airport operations. c123d6b293644214.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تودو أوبس عن محاسب متخصص في تنفيذ نظام Odoo للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة قيادة وتنفيذ مشاريع Odoo للعملاء، بدءًا من تحليل المتطلبات المحاسبية وصولاً إلى التسليم النهائي. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في تنفيذ Odoo. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل الإجراءات والمتطلبات المحاسبية والتشغيلية للعملاء، وتوثيق نطاق المشروع وخطة التنفيذ. تهيئة الحسابات والضرائب والصلاحيات ووحدات Odoo المرتبطة بعمليات العميل، بالإضافة إلى تجهيز ومراجعة الأرصدة والبيانات الأساسية. اختبار القيود والدورات المحاسبية والتقارير والتكامل بين الوحدات، ومعالجة الملاحظات والتنسيق مع المطورين عند الضرورة. تدريب المستخدمين على العمليات المحاسبية والتشغيلية، ومتابعة جاهزية الإطلاق والتسليم وتقديم الدعم الأولي. متابعة نطاق المشروع وجدوله الزمني والمخاطر المحتملة، وإعداد تقارير تقدم المشروع بشكل دوري. توزيع المهام على مساعد التنفيذ عند توفره ومراجعة جودة مخرجاته، مع تحمل المسؤولية الكاملة عن التنفيذ والتسليم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في تنفيذ نظام Odoo. القدرة على قيادة وتنفيذ مشاريع Odoo بشكل مستقل. فهم عميق للإجراءات والمتطلبات المحاسبية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد متطلبات العملاء. القدرة على تهيئة الأنظمة وتجهيز البيانات. مهارات تدريب ممتازة للمستخدمين. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع ومتابعة التقدم. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتنسيق مع الفرق الداخلية والعملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة تودو أوبس بالرياض. يتطلب الدور القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وقيادة مساعد تنفيذ عند الحاجة، مما يعكس طبيعة العمل التعاونية والمسؤوليات المتزايدة مع اتساع نطاق المشاريع. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة في شركة تودو أوبس بالرياض.

c16c6a5cf66931b6.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is focused on developing the entertainment, sports, and culture landscape in Saudi Arabia. The company is seeking an Executive Director for Asian Games Planning and Coordination within its Sports Strategic Business Unit. This is a full-time position (REQ1370) requiring over 15 years of experience. Role Overview The Executive Director will lead major games and event planning and coordination for Qiddiya City, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's strategy and Saudi Vision 2030. This role involves strategic oversight of Qiddiya's executive-level third-party relationships, which are essential for the delivery of the 2034 Asian Games, the 2034 FIFA World Cup, and future global sporting events. The Executive Director will provide executive leadership for Qiddiya’s major sports and events agenda, establishing strategic direction, building organizational capability, and fostering cross-Qiddiya alignment to ensure the destination is development-ready and operationally prepared for these events. Key Responsibilities Develop the overarching strategy for the Sports SBU and Qiddiya’s role in major games and event planning, defining objectives and priorities aligned with Qiddiya strategy and Vision 2030. Ensure all games and event programs contribute to Vision 2030 goals, including sports participation growth, quality of life enhancement, economic diversification, tourism and investment attraction, and positioning the Kingdom as a global sporting destination. Oversee the engagement framework for Qiddiya's involvement in delivering the Asian Games, FIFA World Cup, and future global sporting events. Build and resource the department team, promoting a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Serve as Qiddiya's principal representative and senior contact for international sports federations, organizing committees, and government stakeholders regarding major sporting event planning and coordination. Cultivate executive-level relationships with third parties, ensuring consistent and credible representation of Qiddiya. Manage comprehensive stakeholder engagement plans, coordinating communication across internal and external parties. Oversee cross-functional relationships within Qiddiya to ensure organizational coordination and accountability for event delivery. Act as the strategic interface with Qiddiya Governance and Event Oversight Committees to facilitate cross-functional communication and alignment. Provide oversight of Qiddiya's master plan, venues, infrastructure, and supporting facilities to ensure development and delivery meet event specifications, standards, and timelines. Oversee integrated governance, planning, and reporting mechanisms to track event readiness and manage interdependencies. Act as the central link between external event stakeholders and internal Qiddiya teams, translating host obligations into internal priorities. Manage the department’s budget, forecasts, and resource allocation. Regularly update senior management and the Board on strategy implementation, relationship status, event readiness, and strategic recommendations. Champion a legacy-focused approach, integrating community benefit, fan experience, and long-term destination value into Qiddiya's event contributions. Qualifications and Experience Over 15 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated leadership in major games and event planning and coordination. Experience in building and managing high-performing teams. Proven ability to manage executive-level third-party relationships with government entities, international sports federations, and organizing committees. Strategic understanding of large-scale event delivery and operational readiness. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Sports Strategic Business Unit at Qiddiya Investment Company, focusing on the development and operational readiness of Qiddiya City for major global sporting events. Application Process Candidates interested in this Executive Director role (REQ1370) are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c1addd02da6fcf90.description: About the Role BMC is seeking a Fixed Asset Assistant to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah al Munawwarah. This full-time role is responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of fixed assets, from acquisition and tracking to reporting and disposal. The Fixed Asset Assistant will ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal policies, providing detailed analyses to support financial planning and budgeting. Key Responsibilities Conduct periodic verification of selected stock items. Monitor and report damaged stock, investigating causes to prevent recurrence. Coordinate with the warehouse for receiving supplies from vendors, performing inspections, and supervising transfers to storage locations. Oversee the handover and clearance process for employees on final exit, including asset return. Manage the proper storage and maintenance of assets in warehouses and other storage areas. Ensure accurate data transfer and updates, reporting to the supervisor for updates in ERP-based inventory management systems. Actively participate in inventory-related committees, including: Damaged Stock Committee Slow Moving Items Committee Annual Physical Stocktaking Committee Prepare periodic stocktaking reports, including monthly, quarterly, and annual fixed asset reports. Perform additional duties as assigned to support the Finance department and organizational goals. Qualifications and Experience Education: Diploma degree in Accounting with SOCPA registration. Experience: 0-3 years of experience in accounting. Experience in fixed assets is considered an advantage. c1c96233caf6fc28.job_title: SAP Basis Consultant and Security Consultant
c1c96233caf6fc28.description: About the Role Müller`s Solutions is seeking a certified SAP Authorization Consultant to join an SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation project. This full-time, remote position involves designing and managing user access and security to ensure compliance and alignment with client job functions. The consultant will work closely with functional consultants and client stakeholders from the design phase through go-live. Key Responsibilities Design business roles based on SAP templates, client job functions, and processes. Configure business catalogs, business role templates, and read/write/value help restrictions. Set up SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS) for Single Sign-On (SSO), user provisioning, and integration with the client’s identity provider. Conduct Segregation of Duties (SoD) checks and resolve access conflicts. Manage user creation, role assignment, and access changes through go-live and hypercare phases. Support internal and external audits by performing access reviews and providing documentation. Document role designs and security setups, and address authorization issues and support requests. Qualifications and Experience Certified SAP Authorization Consultant. 2-5 years of experience in SAP authorization and security. Experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations is required. Proficiency in designing and managing user access and security. Familiarity with SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS). Work Environment This is a full-time, remote position. The successful candidate will collaborate with functional consultants and client stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

c1ca249988f11279.description: About Almarai Almarai Company, established in 1977 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is recognized as the world's largest vertically integrated dairy company and a prominent food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Almarai's product portfolio includes dairy products, juices and beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish and seafood, and bottled water, marketed under more than 20 brands such as Almarai, L'usine, 7DAYS, ALYOUM, Nuralac, Farm's Select, Ice Leaf, Almira, Seama, Oska, IVAL, Almara Pro, Premier Chef, and Bakemart. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, Almarai reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. The company's ongoing expansion and acquisitions in new vertical markets contribute to its dynamic multinational team and growth objectives. Role Overview Almarai is seeking an Assistant IT Account Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on enhancing the quality of services provided by the Business Systems Division (BSD) through improvements in application delivery and performance measurement. The position involves coordinating with IT Account Managers (ITA's) and the Head Office to ensure efficient service delivery. Core Purpose of the Role The primary purpose of this role is to maintain and improve the quality of services offered by the Business Systems Division. This involves focusing on application quality, performance, and effective coordination across teams to meet divisional service requirements. Key Responsibilities Ensure the quality of services provided by the Business Systems Division (BSD). Improve the quality of applications delivered. Assist in the development of training materials related to applications. Measure the performance of applications. Coordinate between IT Account Managers (ITA's) and the Head Office to facilitate timely delivery of services required by the Division. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience.

c1d9abe11bd344e5.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager – Social Media to lead and enhance the company's social media presence. This full-time role involves developing and executing social media strategies, focusing on strong storytelling and understanding digital audiences. The position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in social media management. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with brand and marketing objectives. Lead content planning and oversee engaging, relevant, and platform-specific content across social channels. Manage multiple social media campaigns, activations, and priorities from planning through execution. Monitor and report on key metrics including engagement, reach, audience growth, and overall channel performance. Collaborate with Creative, Brand, Content, Media, PR, and other teams to deliver integrated campaigns. Manage agencies, creators, influencers, and other external partners when required. Guide and support the social media team, fostering creativity, collaboration, and high-quality execution. Stay informed on emerging platforms, formats, technologies, and social media best practices. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in social media management or a related field. Work Type This is a full-time position. Compensation Salary for this role will be not disclosed.

c1f1ee52267af2e2.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is an integrated AEP/PMCM firm recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. The company has over 60 years of experience in planning, design, and project delivery across built and natural environments. KEO is also ranked by World Architecture as the 57th largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2023 WA100 Survey. The Role of Lifting Specialist KEO International Consultants is seeking a Lifting Specialist to join its team. This is a full-time position requiring a minimum of 10 years of experience in lifting operations. The specialist will be responsible for overseeing and managing various lifting activities, ensuring compliance with safety standards and operational procedures. Key Responsibilities Supervising crane lifting operations, including tower, mobile, and crawler cranes. Interpreting and executing lifting plans in accordance with approved procedures and safety requirements. Assessing crane load charts, lifting capacities, and working radii to ensure safe lifting operations. Evaluating load weights, centers of gravity, and load stability prior to lifting. Managing rigging and slinging activities, including the selection and use of appropriate lifting accessories. Overseeing crane positioning, outrigger setup, and ground-bearing pressure assessments. Coordinating critical, heavy, and complex lifting operations. Supervising the lifting and placement of precast concrete elements, structural steel, and construction materials. Reviewing and implementing lifting risk assessments, method statements, and permit-to-work requirements. Verifying the inspection, certification, and compliance of cranes and lifting equipment. Establishing and controlling exclusion zones and coordinating simultaneous lifting operations. Monitoring wind speeds and environmental conditions to ensure compliance with lifting restrictions. Coordinating banksmen, slingers, riggers, and crane operators to ensure safe and efficient lifting activities. Enforcing lifting safety procedures, identifying potential hazards, and exercising stop-work authority when unsafe conditions arise. Ensuring compliance with BS 7121, LOLER, and all applicable lifting regulations, codes, and industry standards. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in supervising and managing crane lifting operations. Work Environment and Culture KEO fosters a supportive environment focused on professional development through internal global mobility and career advancement opportunities. The company promotes health and well-being through on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees are invited to participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. The company offers a competitive package and benefits, including hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards, mentoring and coaching programs, and extensive in-house on-demand learning courses.

c14be2ac8f1f690e.description: About Leylaty Group Leylaty Group is seeking a Restaurant Receptionist to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role is essential for ensuring a welcoming atmosphere and efficient guest services within the restaurant. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to welcome and greet guests in a professional and friendly manner, manage table reservations and seating arrangements, and contribute to an exceptional guest experience that aligns with the restaurant's service standards and brand image. Key Responsibilities Welcome and greet guests upon arrival with a professional demeanor. Manage guest seating arrangements in coordination with the service team. Handle telephone and online reservations, including confirmations and follow-ups. Respond to guest inquiries regarding the menu, prices, services, and operating hours. Manage the waiting list and communicate estimated waiting times to guests. Handle special requests, celebrations, and guest preferences in coordination with relevant departments. Address guest complaints and feedback professionally, resolving issues or escalating them to management as needed. Maintain continuous communication with the Restaurant Manager and service team to ensure smooth operations. Ensure the reception area remains clean, organized, and presentable. Maintain accurate reservation records and guest information. Ensure guests leave with a positive impression by thanking and bidding them farewell. Adhere to restaurant policies, procedures, and guest service standards. Authority and Accountabilities Organize and coordinate guest seating based on table availability. Manage and confirm guest reservations. Coordinate special guest requests with relevant departments. Escalate guest complaints and operational issues to the Restaurant Manager. Maintain confidentiality of guest information and reservation records. Key Performance Indicators Guest satisfaction with the reception experience. Accuracy of reservations and seating arrangements. Efficiency in guest waiting times and seating. Number of complaints related to reception services. Compliance with grooming and professional standards. Effective coordination with the restaurant operations team. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. This full-time position is based in Jeddah.

c1922f92523ec5ae.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform focused on emerging markets, with over 25 years of conversational AI research and development. The company serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA and is developing sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. Unifonic fosters a collaborative environment where ideas are welcomed, and employees are shareholders. The Finance Team The finance team at Unifonic supports strategic decision-making, ensures financial health, and delivers value to stakeholders. This team manages financial planning, reporting, procurement, and investor relations, playing a role in supporting all departments and contributing to the company's success. Familiarity with basic treasury functions, including cash positions, cash flow forecasting, electronic payments, and bank reconciliations. Benefits Competitive salary and bonus. GOSI costs covered by the company. Unifonic share scheme. 30 holiday days after the first anniversary. Flexible working arrangements. c1a4dbe8eb231f6c.description: About Kinetico KSA Kinetico, established in 2009, is a boutique fitness and wellness destination located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves delivering dynamic group fitness classes, including heated sessions, and contributing to client engagement and retention. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Lead heated fitness classes multiple times per week in a studio heated to 37–40°C. Design structured and effective workouts suitable for various fitness levels. Demonstrate proper technique, alignment, modifications, and progressions. Create a motivating, welcoming, and supportive environment for clients. Build client relationships and contribute to client engagement and retention efforts. Conduct private and personal training sessions based on client demand. Maintain professional standards, punctuality, and safety protocols. Working Schedule and Compensation This is a full-time position with a six-day working week and one day off. Instructors will teach a maximum of five 50-minute classes per day. Compensation includes a monthly base salary, with additional earning potential through a 30% commission on personal training sessions. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a passionate and certified Pilates or Barre Instructor with 0-1 years of experience. They should be confident in leading dynamic, engaging, and results-driven classes, with a genuine interest in movement, fitness, and client wellbeing. Joining Kinetico KSA Joining Kinetico KSA offers the opportunity to become part of an established boutique fitness brand. The role provides a platform to develop teaching skills, expand expertise in heated fitness, and grow a personal training clientele within a team of instructors and an engaged community.

Role Overview The Key Account Manager will be responsible for generating new business and managing the full sales cycle with corporate, government, and semi-government organizations. Proven track record of personally generating new business. c1c1aaefbf999e28.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فرزه التجارية عن فني نظارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وتعديل وسائل المساعدة البصرية وفقاً للوصفات الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الإرشادات للمرضى حول استخدامها والمحافظة عليها. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب وسائل المساعدة البصرية وضبط مقاساتها بدقة حسب الوصفات الطبية الصادرة عن أخصائيي البصريات وأطباء العيون. تحديد العدسات المناسبة بناءً على مستوى النظر المطلوب وتفسير الوصفات الطبية. تحديد تفضيلات العميل وطلب تصنيع عدسات النظارات بما يتوافق مع هذه التفضيلات والمتطلبات الطبية. تقديم المشورة للعملاء حول اختيار النظارات والإطارات ووسائل المساعدة البصرية الأخرى. إرشاد العملاء حول كيفية تنظيف وصيانة النظارات والعدسات للحفاظ على جودتها وفعاليتها. تعيين زوايا الرؤية لضمان أن العدسات تحدث تأثيراً إيجابياً على رؤية المرضى وراحتهم. التقيد بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المعتمدة في بيئة العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير الوصفات الطبية بدقة. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتقديم المشورة للعملاء بفعالية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني النظارات ضمن فريق مؤسسة فرزه التجارية في بيئة مهنية داعمة. يقع مقر العمل في منطقة القصيم، مع فرص للعمل في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. هذا الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

c1e6270dd0a11524.description: About Rosewood Hotel Group Rosewood Hotel Group operates with the purpose of inspiring imaginations and enriching lives, guided by its philosophy, A Sense of Place®. The company focuses on creating experiences that reflect the culture, history, and spirit of each destination. Rosewood Hotel Group values its employees as its greatest asset, fostering an environment for talent development and growth. The Role of Engineering Administrative Assistant The Engineering Administrative Assistant will join the Engineering team in Saudi Arabia, providing administrative and organizational support to ensure the department's smooth and efficient operation. This full-time position reports to the Assistant Director of Engineering and involves close collaboration with various hotel departments. The role is central to supporting daily engineering administration and communication. Key Responsibilities Support the Engineering team with day-to-day administrative and clerical duties. Maintain accurate departmental records, files, and documentation. Assist in preparing reports, presentations, correspondence, and meeting minutes. Coordinate schedules, appointments, and departmental meetings as required. Support inventory, purchasing, and invoice-tracking administration. c1505066c33e3d55.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج، واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية والدعائية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية، ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للسوق للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها بشكل نهائي، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف وتطوير السياسات التسويقية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المتخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد. ستتاح للموظف فرصة للمساهمة في تطوير استراتيجيات التسويق لمنتجات الشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجال التسويق.

This approach offers a safer, faster, and more water-efficient alternative to traditional cleaning methods, eliminating the need for scaffolding, rope access, and associated height risks. The Sales Representative will report directly to the General Manager. Key Responsibilities Identify and contact potential clients, including property owners, facility managers, developers, and solar operators. Arrange meetings and site visits to present Clean Birds' drone cleaning services. Prepare quotations in collaboration with the General Manager and follow up to close deals. Develop long-term client relationships and secure recurring maintenance contracts. Maintain an up-to-date client pipeline and sales activity records. Represent Clean Birds at industry events and meetings. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a sales role. Demonstrated ability to build and manage client relationships. Experience in preparing and presenting sales proposals. Benefits of Joining Clean Birds Opportunity to sell a service with clear advantages in safety, speed, and environmental impact. c102482f8c579f13.job_title: Lead Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Metro/Rail Project
c102482f8c579f13.description: About Systra SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs safe and sustainable transport solutions globally, focusing on social inclusion and access to essential services. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing their infrastructure and transport systems across the project lifecycle, from design to maintenance. SYSTRA operates in over 80 countries and generates 74% of its turnover internationally, supporting clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. Role Overview SYSTRA is seeking a Lead Operation and Maintenance (O&M) expert for a Metro/Rail Project in Riyadh. This full-time role involves acting as a subject matter expert in operation and maintenance for Automatic Metro Systems. The primary responsibility is to ensure the operability and maintainability of the transportation system, including all sub-systems and equipment provided by the Contractor, in compliance with contractual requirements throughout all project phases. The project aims to achieve the highest international standards for railway systems. Key Responsibilities Establish documentation review reports in a timely manner, adhering to project schedules and quality policies. Report on compliance and deviations during relevant design progress meetings. Maintain privacy in communications with various stakeholders. Organize workshops and meetings with contractors to identify gaps, facilitate solutions, and ensure submission timelines. Report to the Package Manager, System Manager, and Design Manager on pending issues and potential non-compliance. Issue weekly progress reports. Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and site tests, both locally and internationally. Act as an Operation and Maintenance expert on behalf of the Engineer to the Employer, as requested. Provide expert advice within the Engineer team regarding the operability and maintainability of various sub-systems (E&M, Signaling, Track, Civil work, Rolling stock, Communication, External stakeholders). Implement required reporting to generate relevant project information. Provide constraints to sub-systems. Communicate inputs clearly and in a controlled manner to relevant parties. Manage design changes and ensure they are communicated and adequately addressed by the Contractor. Ensure consistency of design produced by sub-systems. Verify compliance of sub-systems with allocated requirements and check traceability evidence between requirement definition and design compliance. Define appropriate actions and prepare technical requests and follow-ups. Translate operating requirements into specific criteria for sub-system management. Manage train operation during construction activities. Participate in Operational Site Tests (OST). Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in Operation and Maintenance, specifically within Metro/Rail projects. Demonstrated expertise in Automatic Metro Systems. Strong understanding of transportation system sub-systems and equipment. Ability to ensure compliance with contractual requirements and international railway standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within a dynamic team focused on delivering high-standard public transport solutions.

Develop new business with existing clients and identify areas for improvement to meet sales quotas. Forecast and track key account metrics, including quarterly sales results and annual forecasts. Prepare reports on account status. Collaborate with the sales team to identify and grow opportunities within the assigned territory. Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations as required. Operational Duties Adhere to all relevant policies, procedures, and processes to ensure consistent daily operations. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in processes, practices, cost-effectiveness, and productivity. Promote the implementation and adherence to policies, procedures, and instructions among colleagues. Follow daily operational procedures to ensure work continuity. Contribute to preparing timely and accurate reports related to the job to meet requirements and objectives. Ensure satisfaction for both internal and external customers by addressing their needs courteously and promptly. Qualifications 1-2 years of relevant experience. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Jeddah. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c1a032be7cace9c1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اوفر لي للتجارة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية وضمان دقة السجلات المحاسبية، مع التركيز على قطاع التجزئة والأسواق المركزية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مجموعة من المهام المالية والمحاسبية لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة ودقة، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تسجيل القيود اليومية للمبيعات والمشتريات والمصروفات في النظام المحاسبي. مطابقة مبيعات نقاط البيع (POS) يومياً مع النقد في الصناديق وتحويلات الشبكة، ومتابعة الفروقات مع الكاشيرية والمشرفين. إعداد التسويات البنكية بشكل دوري. مراجعة فواتير الموردين ومطابقتها مع أوامر الشراء وسندات الاستلام، ومتابعة المستحقات والسداد. متابعة حركة المخزون والمشاركة في الجرد الدوري ومعالجة فروقات الجرد. إعداد إقرارات ضريبة القيمة المضافة والزكاة والالتزام بمتابعة متطلبات الفوترة الإلكترونية (فاتورة). إعداد التقارير المالية الشهرية مثل قائمة الدخل وتقارير المبيعات والمصروفات وهوامش الربح. متابعة العُهد والمصروفات النثرية وتسويتها. إعداد الموازنة ومراقبة التكاليف. حفظ المستندات والسجلات المالية بشكل منظم وتجهيزها للمراجعة الخارجية. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: شهادة بكالوريوس في المحاسبة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. يُفضل وجود خبرة سابقة في قطاع التجزئة والأسواق المركزية. القدرة على العمل وفق الأنظمة المحاسبية المعتمدة في المملكة ومتطلبات هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب هذا الدور مجموعة من المهارات الأساسية لضمان الأداء الفعال: الدقة العالية في تسجيل ومراجعة البيانات المالية. الأمانة والنزاهة في التعامل مع السجلات المالية. القدرة على التعامل مع حجم كبير من العمليات المالية اليومية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في الباحة، وهو دوام كامل في سوبرماركت. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بضمان دقة وسلامة السجلات المالية في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. تقديم الطلبات الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

c1a52c2453372e35.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform recognized as a Great Place to Work®. c1e8fb5bbfcb6f08.description: About the Role Echelon is seeking a Partner Portfolio Lead Architect to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role reports to the Head of Partner Strategy and is responsible for leading the decision-making process regarding which partners are integrated into Echelon’s portfolio and under what terms. The role involves evaluating potential partners against key criteria and collaborating with various internal teams to finalize agreements. Key Responsibilities Lead the assessment of potential partners based on technology, industry, layer within the stack, and mutual fit, presenting recommendations to the leadership team. Collaborate with engineering leadership to evaluate candidates' architecture, maturity, security, and deployability, including required engineering effort. Validate industry demand, sectors, use cases, and accounts with account teams prior to commitment. Determine the partner's position in the technology stack and assess if that layer requires filling, strengthening, or should remain open. Evaluate strategic intent, commercial ambition, operational methods, and appetite for joint investment to ensure mutual commitment. Assess each new partner's addition relative to the company roadmap and existing partners, identifying gaps, overlaps, or competition to ensure a cohesive market offering. Recommend partnership models and negotiate terms, including go-to-market strategies, delivery, revenue share, exclusivity, liabilities, and exit clauses, with leadership, Legal, Finance, and business units. Develop partner profiles, assessment frameworks, recruitment processes, and the operating model for partner transitions in collaboration with leadership and Partner Sourcing and Intelligence. Required Qualifications and Skills Experience in assessing, structuring, and signing partnerships at a technology vendor, integrator, or in corporate development or consulting. Ability to engage engineers on architecture, integration, and deployment, and to discern robust technology from demonstrations. Deep understanding of how sectors acquire and utilize technology, with the ability to judge where value will be created. Experience in designing channel/partnership models and negotiating revenue share or terms with larger counterparties. Credibility with founders, engineers, Legal, and Finance, with the ability to assess how partners contribute to the overall portfolio. Strong communication skills to simplify complex systems and articulate the value of work. Comfortable progressing with partial data and in ambiguous environments. Ability to test claims against data and explain decisions. Advantageous Experience Experience within a technology vendor’s partner organization or a cloud provider’s ecosystem team. Exposure to venture investment, M&A, or joint ventures, including diligence and documentation. Depth of knowledge in sectors where Echelon operates, such as government, energy, financial services, and healthcare. Work Environment and Values This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with limited travel. Echelon values a customer-first approach, ownership mentality, clear communication, comfort with ambiguity, and a long-term building perspective. The company fosters an environment of curiosity, speed, rigor, confidence balanced with humility, autonomy, resourcefulness, and situational leadership. The use of AI tools for research, assessment, and negotiation is integral to the work process. Compensation The compensation package includes a base salary, housing, transport, and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. c1e9147028c8d551.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سنا للكهرباء والهاتف عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتدقيق حسابات البنوك. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. مهارات في إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق شركة سنا للكهرباء والهاتف في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح له تطبيق وتطوير مهاراته المحاسبية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في الرياض.

c1f7e7b6279f92d3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل والمشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. فهم قوي لمبادئ التصميم الكهربائي وشبكات النقل والتوزيع. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلول الإصلاح. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في مجموعة المجال العربي بالهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لمتابعة المشاريع والأعمال الهندسية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجموعة المجال العربي.

c10776fa276b1d94.description: Job description Company Description Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene. Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities. About LIONS Riyadh LIONS Riyadh marks a bold new chapter for the world’s most prestigious platform for creative marketing. Launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, it is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community, home to the renowned Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry. Job Description The Head of Content will lead the creative and editorial vision for LIONS Riyadh, shaping the ideas, conversations, voices and experiences that define the Festival. This is not a traditional conference production role. The Head of Content will be a curator, storyteller, creative strategist and industry connector , someone with exceptional editorial judgement, deep curiosity and the ability to recognise the ideas and people capable of moving the industry forward. Responsible for the overall strategic direction of the entire content strategy. Working in close partnership with LIONS, the role will translate the global authority, creative standards and cultural relevance of the LIONS brand into a programme that feels unmistakably LIONS while being genuinely rooted in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. The successful candidate will build a content proposition capable of attracting the world's most influential CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands, creators, cultural voices and next-generation talent to Riyadh. They will create a Festival programme that goes beyond stages and panels connecting content, creativity, culture, learning, brand experiences, networking and extraordinary talent into one compelling Festival journey. Ensure the content team consistently delivers world-class, culturally relevant and commercially powerful content worthy of the LIONS brand. Key Responsibilities Lead the overall content strategy and direction for LIONS Riyadh, ensuring it reflects the LIONS brand, global standards and regional relevance. Develop and curate the overall programme across creativity, marketing, media, culture, technology and the future of the industry, including stages, talks, workshops, masterclasses and other Festival formats. Build and manage the speaker strategy, securing leading global and regional CMOs, creative leaders, brands, agencies, creators and cultural figures. Manage the content budget, including speaker costs, travel, moderators, producers and programme-related expenditure. Build strong relationships with local and international creative communities, industry leaders, advisory board members and strategic content partners. Lead and develop the content production team, including resourcing, scheduling, coaching, performance management and professional development. Work with Marketing and PR to use content, speakers and thought leadership to build audience demand and strengthen the Festival brand. Sponsorship direction and sales briefings to the wider team to ensure they understand the objectives and USPs when pitching to clients to secure deals. Work with Commercial and Partnerships teams to develop relevant branded-content opportunities without compromising editorial quality. Government liaison and technical aspects across all relevant projects. Work closely with Event, Marketing, Creative, Commercial and Operations teams to ensure content is fully integrated into the overall Festival experience. Work with department heads to develop year-round content strategies that increase audience engagement, commercial value and long-term impact. Overall team management, appropriate resourcing, coaching and mentorship of team members. KPI’s Timely delivery and quality of conference programmes. Strategy development and delivery. Quality and strength of the speaker line-up. Audience engagement and satisfaction across content sessions. Successful delivery of LIONS-aligned content and creative standards. Content contribution to PR, marketing and audience growth. Strength of relationships with key industry leaders, speakers and creative communities. Main Duties & Responsibilities: Own the content production timeline, ensuring key programme, speaker and delivery milestones are achieved on time.
